select sum(money) from pay_details where state=1 and `type`=2
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{time},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{time},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{time},'%Y')

select sum(money) from pay_details where 1=1
and state=#{state}
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{time},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{time},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{time},'%Y')

select sum(money) from pay_details where 1=1
and classify=#{classify}
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{time},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{time},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{time},'%Y')
and pay_classify=#{payClassify}
and state=1
select sum(money) from pay_details where 1 = 1 and date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m') = date_format(#{date}, '%Y-%m') and state = 1 and user_id = #{userId}
select count(*) from pay_details where `state` = 1 and user_id = #{userId}

select IFNULL(SUM(money),0) from pay_details p where state=1
and classify = #{classify}
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(create_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{date},'%Y')

select IFNULL(SUM(p.money),0.00) from pay_details p left join orders to1 on to1.order_num = p.order_id where p.state=1 and to1.status = 9
and date_format(p.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(p.create_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(p.create_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{date},'%Y')

select ifnull(sum(pd.money),0.00) from pay_details pd left join orders to1 on to1.order_num = pd.order_id where pd.state=1
and date_format(pd.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m-%d')
and date_format(pd.create_time,'%Y-%m')=date_format(#{date},'%Y-%m')
and date_format(pd.create_time,'%Y')=date_format(#{date},'%Y')
